data.name: Sharveera
data.gender_notes: Sharveera is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharveera is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Sharva' meaning 'God of Power' and 'Iina' meaning 'Goddess'. The name Sharveera is a tribute to the Goddess of power and strength. It represents a woman who is powerful, strong, and beautiful. The name Sharveera carries the meaning “Goddess of power and strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharveera usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of power and strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sharveera is believed to have spiritual significance as it is derived from the names of Hindu deities. It is a reminder of the divine feminine power within all women.
data.etymology: Sharveera belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of power and strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharveera total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
